inspection: Read-only static HTML parsing of the user-supplied archive; no archived scripts or programs executed.
interpretation: Normalized technical facts from all 41 complete records in seven transfer batches; source expression and solution implementations excluded.
A reference observation is not automatically a mandatory task rule.
Bounded valid domains and deterministic bank adapters are disclosed separately.
No private archive paths are retained.

questions.title: 2nd Largest Item in a Binary Search Tree
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: No tree mutation. Valid BST; second-largest returns the integer key, not a node reference. Null/singleton reference rejects with ArgumentException. O(h) time, O(1) auxiliary.
questions.uncertainties: Duplicate policy/second-distinct interpretation unspecified; malformed/cyclic structures unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: Keys are distinct. Valid trees have 2..2000 nodes; integer keys fit signed 32 bits.

questions.title: Apple Stocks
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Exactly one earlier purchase and later sale at distinct indices. Declining prices require the least-negative feasible difference; equal prices yield zero. Read-only reference. Fewer than two prices: reference ArgumentException. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null and numeric overflow unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: There are 2..10000 prices, each in 0..1000000.

questions.title: Balanced Binary Tree
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Global maximum leaf depth minus minimum leaf depth <= 1; leaf has neither child. One-leaf chains pass. Empty reference true. Preserve tree. O(n) time, O(h) traversal storage, O(n) worst case.
questions.uncertainties: Cycles/shared-node non-trees unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: Empty trees return true. Valid input is a finite tree with at most 2000 nodes.

questions.title: Binary Search Tree Checker
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Inherited ancestor restrictions, not just parent comparisons. Main references strict ordering and reject duplicates. No mutation. Recursive empty true; iterative lacks guard. Reference endpoint-bound bug is identified as a bonus issue, not a required rejection. O(n)/O(h).
questions.uncertainties: Empty behavior differs by reference. Full int range unresolved by base reference. Duplicate-placement variants are optional bonus.
questions.bankConventions: Empty trees are valid. Duplicates are rejected. Full signed 32-bit keys, including endpoints, are supported; bounds must not accidentally exclude endpoints.

questions.title: Bracket Validator
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Raw ASCII (), [], {} matching and nesting. Reject unmatched closer, wrong/crossing type, leftover opener. Reference ignores other characters, accepts empty/no-delimiter strings, scans delimiter characters inside quotes/comments. O(n)/O(n).
questions.uncertainties: Null unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: ASCII strings of length at most 10000. Quotes and comments have no special syntax; their delimiter characters are scanned too.

questions.title: Cafe Order Checker
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Exact interleaving preserving each source order. IDs globally unique, not numerically sorted. Arrays read-only. Empty sources permitted, all-empty true. Extra/unknown/duplicated/missing served entries false. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null unspecified. Duplicate source IDs outside domain.
questions.bankConventions: Source IDs are globally unique signed 32-bit integers. Each array has at most 10000 entries.

questions.title: Compute the nth Fibonacci Number
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: F(0)=0, F(1)=1; recurrence is sum of prior two. Negative reference rejected (ArgumentException or ArgumentOutOfRangeException depending variant). O(n)/O(1); logarithmic bonus optional.
questions.uncertainties: Upper bound/overflow unspecified; exact negative-input exception subtype inconsistent.
questions.bankConventions: The judge uses 0 <= n <= 46 so the result fits a signed 32-bit integer.

questions.title: Delete Node
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Only target reference supplied, no head/predecessor. Required mutation logically removes target position by preserving target object but copying successor value/Next and bypassing successor. Aliases observe these effects. Non-tail normal domain; head allowed. Tail reference InvalidOperationException. O(1)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null/cyclic input unspecified. Physical removal of target object is not reference behavior.
questions.bankConventions: Cases encode the complete finite list plus a zero-based target index. The submitted API receives only that node. At least two nodes; target is not the tail. Aliases to both target and successor are checked.

questions.title: Does This Linked List Have A Cycle?
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Cycle depends on node identity, not values; only reachable nodes matter. Preserve links/values. Empty false, single-null-next false, self-loop true, prefixed cycle true. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: No unresolved valid-domain facts.
questions.bankConventions: Cases contain values and a zero-based tail-link target, or -1 for null. At most 2000 reachable nodes.

questions.title: Find Duplicate Files
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Read-only recursive filesystem search; full-path OriginalPath/DuplicatePath pairs denote suspected duplicates for human confirmation. At most one duplicate per original. Bounded sampling O(f) allows false positives; exact verification optional with byte-proportional cost. Later LastWriteTime reference labeled duplicate; heuristic fallible. Empty [] and nested/sibling search. Equal timestamps/traversal ties unspecified. O(f) fingerprints/paths.
questions.uncertainties: Controlled filesystem adapter needed. Missing/inaccessible paths, I/O failures, symlinks/hardlinks/directory cycles/concurrent changes unspecified. Output order, timestamp ties, proof of original, exact-vs-probabilistic judging unresolved.
questions.bankConventions: Controlled ordinary files and directories only, no links or I/O failures. The adapter defines deterministic sampling: size plus up to 64 bytes at offsets 0, floor(max(0,size-64)/2), and max(0,size-64). Candidate groups contain at most two files. All matching groups must be reported once; output ordering is free. Equal-time orientation is free. Examples display paths relative to the controlled directory; the submitted function returns full paths. Sample collisions are accepted as suspected duplicates. This disclosed fingerprint convention makes the source's approximate task executable.

questions.title: Find Repeat, Space Edition
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Length n+1, entries 1..n. Any actual repeated value accepted, multiple repeated values and frequency >2 permitted. Non-destructive required. O(n log n)/O(1) target.
questions.uncertainties: Null/too-short/out-of-range outside valid domain; no rejection rule.
questions.bankConventions: 2..10000 entries; valid pigeonhole domain only. Any duplicated value is accepted, not one fixed reference choice.

questions.title: Find Repeat, Space Edition BEAST MODE
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Same length/range domain as preceding task. Any repeated value, multiple duplicates/higher frequencies valid. Non-destructive required. O(n)/O(1) target.
questions.uncertainties: Null and invalid domain unspecified; no particular reference-selected duplicate required.
questions.bankConventions: 2..10000 entries in the stated domain. Any actual repeated value is valid.

questions.title: Find Rotation Point
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Rotated alphabetically ordered lowercase words, ordinal reference comparison; principal scenario actual internal wrap. Return zero-based wrap index. Read-only. Singleton reference 0. O(log n) comparisons, O(L log n) character work/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Empty/null unspecified. Unrotated old reference last-index result is incidental, not mandatory. Duplicates/ambiguous wrap, null entries/non-lowercase collation unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 1..10000 distinct lowercase ASCII words. The bank explicitly extends the wrapped-list scenario to an unrotated array, whose answer is 0; no old incidental last-index behavior is required.

questions.title: Graph Coloring
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Undirected node-reference graph with string Label, neighbor-reference set, writable Color. Mutate Color only; preserve graph identity/connectivity. Any valid assignment using maximum-degree-plus-one colors, enough distinct palette names. Color disconnected/isolated vertices. Empty returns. Self-edge reference ArgumentException. O(V+E) stated target; O(D) auxiliary.
questions.uncertainties: Initial colors, duplicate/insufficient palettes, nulls, omitted neighbors/asymmetric adjacency unspecified. Failure may partially recolor; no atomicity, color choice or order requirement.
questions.bankConventions: Cases encode a zero-based adjacency list; labels are v0, v1, ... . Simple undirected graphs of at most 200 nodes, initially uncolored. Palette has at least D+1 distinct nonempty ASCII names. Self-loops are outside the valid domain.

questions.title: Highest Product of 3
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Choose exactly three distinct positions, >=3 values. Signed ordering, negatives/zero/repeated values valid. Read-only reference. Short reference ArgumentException. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null/overflow/input numeric limits unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 3..10000 entries in -1000..1000, so three-value products fit signed 32 bits.

questions.title: Implement A Queue With Two Stacks
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: QueueTwoStacks Enqueue/Dequeue state, retain each occurrence, FIFO any interleaving. Explicit two stacks, push/pop O(1). Empty new/drained reference InvalidOperationException. Total O(m), amortized O(1), storage queued count.
questions.uncertainties: Concurrency/capacity unspecified; no worst-case O(1) each Dequeue requirement.
questions.bankConventions: The case adapter constructs one fresh instance and applies each operation in order. Empty-state exceptions are normalized to {"error":"empty"}; exception text is not graded.

questions.title: In-Place Shuffle
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: In-place mutable array; preserve identity/length/multiset, duplicate values are distinct occurrences. Supplied inclusive GetRandom(lower,upper), unbiased full permutations intended. Empty/single no change. O(n) one pass/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: No seed/stream/exact output/statistical tolerance specified; null unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: The bank injects the random primitive. Small distinct arrays are checked under every sequence of legal choices, so all n! permutations must occur equally often. Additional deterministic seeded trials check input identity, multiplicity, bounds and use of the supplied source. Displayed output true means all properties passed, not a required exact permutation.

questions.title: Inflight Entertainment
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Exactly two different entries sum to target. Same entry cannot be reused, two equal durations at different positions allowed. Read-only. Fewer than two false. Optimize time over memory; O(n)/O(n).
questions.uncertainties: Null, negative/zero duration domain, numeric bounds and overflow unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: Durations and target are integers in 0..1000000. At most 10000 movie entries.

questions.title: Kth to Last Node in a Singly-Linked List
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: One-based k from tail; return original node identity, no mutation/copy. Nonempty finite list in examples/reference. k=1 tail, k=length head; invalid k reference ArgumentOutOfRangeException. O(n)/O(1); one pass not required.
questions.uncertainties: Empty/null and cyclic input unspecified; recursion O(n) stack misses space goal.
questions.bankConventions: 1 <= k <= list length <= 2000. The adapter reports the returned original node's zero-based index, allowing identity rather than value-only judging.

questions.title: Largest Stack
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: MaxStack Push/Pop/GetMax integers, built-in Stack restriction. LIFO occurrences, getter non-consuming, repeated maxima survive one pop. Empty Pop/Peek reference InvalidOperationException. O(1) each/O(m) operations bound.
questions.uncertainties: Capacity/concurrency/exception message unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: A fresh object is constructed for each operation sequence. Empty-state exceptions use the same normalized wire category as the queue.

questions.title: Making Change
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Unordered coin combinations, unlimited repetition; nonnegative target and positive denominations presumed. Read-only reference. Zero target one even no denominations; impossible/empty positive zero; oversized coin contributes none. O(A*d)/O(A).
questions.uncertainties: Repeated denomination entries unresolved (old reference separate passes); negative/zero domain undefined. Count overflow unspecified; final method name observed not independently mandated.
questions.bankConventions: 0 <= amount <= 100. Denominations are distinct positive integers <= 100. All corpus counts fit signed 32 bits.

questions.title: Merge Sorted Arrays
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Two already nondecreasing arrays, preserve all occurrences, no deduplication. New result, inputs unchanged. Empty either/both permitted. O(m+n) time/result space.
questions.uncertainties: Null/unsorted outside specified domain; intermediate names differ, final MergeArrays.
questions.bankConventions: Each input has at most 10000 entries; signed 32-bit keys.

questions.title: Merging Meeting Times
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Unsorted integer Meeting intervals StartTime/EndTime; condensed ascending union, merge touching boundaries. New list/new Meeting objects, preserve original order/fields. Nesting/duplicates/chains valid; singleton new object. O(n log n)/O(n); sorted case O(n).
questions.uncertainties: Empty old reference indexes first; not deliberate required failure. Null/reversed/zero duration unspecified, numeric overflow/range conversion unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: Bank intervals have StartTime < EndTime and coordinates in -1000000..1000000. An empty input returns an empty new list as an explicit bank extension.

questions.title: MeshMessage
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Unweighted map string->string[]; any minimum-edge route including endpoints; null unreachable; start=end existing gives singleton. Endpoint missing reference ArgumentException. Cycles terminate, map read-only/new route. Context undirected, reference follows supplied directions; neighbor keys assumed. O(V+E)/O(V).
questions.uncertainties: Nulls, missing non-endpoint keys, asymmetric maps unspecified; no tied-route/neighbor-order mandate.
questions.bankConventions: Every neighbor has a key. Start/end keys exist. The bank uses undirected networks with at most 200 vertices. Any equally short route is accepted.

questions.title: MillionGazillion
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Original task storage-efficiency design; observed Trie.AddWord runnable adapter returns true first exact insertion, false repeat. Stateful sharing, prefixes not implicitly complete keys, empty reference new once. No URL normalization/network/casefolding. O(L) compatible, prefix-saving input-dependent.
questions.uncertainties: No deletion/lookup API specified. NUL collides with reference marker but not meaningful specified URL. Null unspecified; observed adapter must be labeled.
questions.bankConventions: This is a runnable AddWord adapter to a storage-design task, not a claim that the source mandates this only API. Keys are ASCII strings without NUL, length <= 1000; no URL normalization or network access. Empty key is supported explicitly.

questions.title: Parenthesis Matching
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Given valid opener index, return matching closer index respecting nesting; other chars ignored, no mutation/substrings. C# UTF-16 positions. No closer reference ArgumentException. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null/out-of-range/non-opener index validation unspecified; no quote/escape parser semantics.
questions.bankConventions: ASCII strings length <= 10000. The supplied index points to an opener with a matching closer. Indexing is zero-based.

questions.title: Permutation Palindrome
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Lowercase string, all occurrences reordered, no insertion/removal/normalization. Empty/single reference true. Not necessarily originally palindrome. O(n)/O(k), fixed alphabet constant.
questions.uncertainties: Lowercase Unicode repertoire unspecified, no casefold/ignore punctuation/null/normalization; reference char units not graphemes.
questions.bankConventions: ASCII lowercase a..z only; length <= 10000. No punctuation removal or case conversion.

questions.title: Product of All Other Numbers
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Each result position product of all others, same length; division forbidden, negatives/zeros/multiple zeros valid. Reference new array, inputs unchanged, fewer than two ArgumentException. O(n), one extra n-array only.
questions.uncertainties: Mutation not independently specified beyond reference; null/overflow unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 2..20 integers in -5..5; corpus inputs keep every intermediate/result within signed 32 bits.

questions.title: Rectangular Love
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Axis-parallel lower-left int rectangles, positive-area common region. Containment/identical valid. Edge/point contact no overlap. Reference new output/nonmutating and all-zero nonnull sentinel. O(1)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Question allows reasonable no-overlap handling; zero sentinel is reference choice. Negative dimensions/null/overflow unspecified. Zero dimensions reference no-overlap.
questions.bankConventions: Coordinates are in -1000000..1000000, widths/heights in 1..1000000. The bank represents no positive-area overlap by a new Rectangle(0,0,0,0).

questions.title: Recursive String Permutations
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Set of all distinct character permutations, order irrelevant. Recursion required, loops allowed. Initial domain unique characters; reference set dedups repeats. Empty singleton empty string; singleton input itself. No optimization target.
questions.uncertainties: Repeated chars outside initial domain though reference handles them; null/Unicode grapheme/surrogate unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: ASCII strings of at most 7 characters. Repeated-character inputs are an explicit bank extension and use distinct-result set semantics.

questions.title: Reverse A Linked List
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Reverse finite linked list in-place, existing objects reused, values remain on objects, old head becomes tail Next null. Return new head. Empty null, singleton same object. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Cyclic input unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 0..2000 nodes. Identity and link direction are checked independently of values.

questions.title: Reverse String in Place
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Void mutation of provided char array, reverse elements, same identity/length. Empty/single unchanged. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null/grapheme/surrogate semantics unspecified; C# char elements API.
questions.bankConventions: Cases encode ASCII character arrays as strings; the submitted method receives a mutable char array (a one-character string list in Python/JavaScript).

questions.title: Reverse Words
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Void in-place word-order reversal, preserve within-word spelling, same char array identity/length. Letters/spaces with one separator, unequal word lengths; empty/single reference unchanged. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Leading/trailing/repeated spaces, null, other whitespace, graphemes unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: ASCII letters with exactly one space between adjacent words, no leading/trailing spaces. Empty message is supported. Cases encode the mutable array as a string.

questions.title: Simulate 5-sided die
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Rand5 no parameters, use supplied uniform Rand7 1..7 only; output uniform 1..5, range alone insufficient. O(1) space, unbounded worst-case source draws explicitly allowed.
questions.uncertainties: No injection/seed/stream/statistical threshold; source-draw independence implicit model.
questions.bankConventions: The adapter injects source draws and verifies all accepted outcomes, rejection paths, source use and deterministic seeded distribution trials. true denotes passed properties. No fixed random output is required.

questions.title: Simulate 7-sided die
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Rand7 no parameters, use supplied uniform Rand5 1..5 only; output uniform 1..7. Two calls per attempt suffice optimized goal, not three. O(1) space, unbounded worst-case runtime allowed.
questions.uncertainties: No injection/seed/stream/statistical threshold; source-draw independence implicit.
questions.bankConventions: The injected-source adapter enumerates the 25 equally likely draw pairs with fallback streams, tests rejection and verifies seeded output balance/source use. true denotes passed properties, not a fixed rolled value.

questions.title: Temperature Tracker
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: TempTracker Insert 0..110, nullable GetMin/Max/Mean/Mode in final reference. State retains all readings; getters non-consuming. Any tied mode accepted. Empty final getters null, mean floating. O(1) operations/fixed-domain space.
questions.uncertainties: Question describes nonnullable getters but final code nullable. Invalid temp/overflow/mean tolerance unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: At most 10000 operations; temperatures 0..110. Empty getters return null. Means use relative/absolute tolerance 1e-9; any frequency-maximizing mode is accepted.

questions.title: The Cake Thief
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Unlimited whole CakeType items, nonnegative int Weight/long Value/capacity, maximize value under capacity, unused space permitted. Read-only. Zero-weight positive value unbounded even capacity zero; reference InfinityException. Zero-zero no effect, empty/zero bounded capacity 0. O(t*k)/O(k).
questions.uncertainties: Constructor reference narrows int despite long property; preserve long capability. Cross-language infinite wire unspecified; null/negative outside domain/long overflow unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 0 <= capacity <= 200; at most 30 types. Weight <= 200 and Value <= 10000000000, with long results fitting signed 64 bits. Infinite optimum is signaled by InfinityException (or corresponding language exception), normalized to {"error":"infinite"}.

questions.title: The Stolen Breakfast Drone
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Unordered positive int IDs, exactly one once, every other twice; not consecutive/sorted/compact. Return unique value, no mutation. Singleton valid. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Empty/null/multiplicity violations unspecified; do not require incidental invalid behavior.
questions.bankConventions: 1..10001 entries in 1..2147483647, satisfying the exact multiplicity rule.

questions.title: Top Scores
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Scores in 0..K; descending output preserves multiplicity. Reference new array/nonmutation, empty/single supported. O(n+K) time/space incl result, O(n) when K fixed.
questions.uncertainties: No independent no-mutation restriction beyond reference; null/negative K/out-of-range unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: 0 <= K <= 1000; at most 10000 scores, each in 0..K.

questions.title: Which Appears Twice
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: Length n+1, every 1..n present once except sole twice, n>=1. Return sole duplicate, read-only. Minimal [1,1], short ref ArgumentException. O(n)/O(1).
questions.uncertainties: Null/invalid multiplicities unspecified. int sum intermediate overflow is incidental, not mandate; numeric bounds absent.
questions.bankConventions: 1 <= n <= 100000. The exact range and multiplicities are guaranteed. The algorithm must avoid overflowing sum formulas.

questions.title: Word Cloud Data
questions.verifiedTechnicalFacts: WordCloudData constructor/property dictionary counts tokens, input unchanged, order irrelevant. Sensible case aggregation and hyphenation/punctuation considered; policy deliberately flexible. Reference lowercase+initial capital merge, retain capital if no lowercase; internal apostrophes/letter-surrounded hyphens. Empty {}. One input traversal/O(n), dictionary only growing structure.
questions.uncertainties: Exact lexical/case policy intentionally unresolved. All-uppercase/mixed/locale/Unicode/apostrophe boundaries/whitespace not complete; ad hoc reference punctuation not authoritative; null/count overflow unspecified.
questions.bankConventions: The source permits several reasonable lexical/capitalization policies. This deterministic ASCII/lowercase policy is an explicit bank convention, not a uniquely mandated source grammar. Input length <= 10000.
